source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.2 (PDF 209), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Business plan karobar shuru karne aur chalane ke liye ek naqshe (map) ki tarah hai. Yeh mansooba banane mein madad deta hai ke aap kya karna chahte hain, kaise karenge aur kaise kamyab honge.

blocks.prompt: Business plan ko naqshe (map) jaisa kyun kaha gaya hai?
blocks.explanation: Naqshe ki tarah business plan dikhata hai ke kahan pohanchna hai aur kaunsa raasta lena hai, is liye raste mein bhatakne ka imkan kam ho jata hai.

items: Business plan: kya karna hai, kaise karna hai aur kamyabi kaise milegi, is ka naqsha.
